## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for the user?

## Validation

Describe the relevant tests and, for UI changes, the actual app interactions checked.
For provider work, separate simulated protocol tests from live account tests.

## Review

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff, including any AI-generated changes.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private logs, or account-specific fixtures are included.
- [ ] New dependencies and copied code have source and license attribution.
- [ ] Visible UI text and behavior stay within the intended scope.
